chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shamoun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Asamm, from Misma ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The distance between a drinking well and a drinking well is forty cubits, and the distance between an irrigating well and an irrigating well is sixty cubits, and the distance between a spring and a spring is five hundred cubits. And the road, when its people dispute over it, its boundary is seven cubits.'
ai.seo_question: What are the prescribed distances between different types of water wells in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific legal boundaries (hadd) for water sources—forty cubits for drinking wells, sixty for irrigation, and five hundred for natural springs—to prevent communal disputes. It also defines the width of a disputed road as seven cubits, reflecting the practical jurisprudence (fiqh) of the Ahl al-Bayt in managing shared resources and property rights in early Islamic society.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman Al Samma, from Misma’a Bin Abdul Malik,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘What (distance) is to be between the drinking well to a drinking well, is of forty cubits, and what is to be between the irrigating well to an irrigating well is of sixty cubits’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Shammun from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman al-Asamm from Misma’ ibn ‘Abd al-Malik who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, assigned the distance between two wells for drinking water to be forty Dhira‘ (arms length) and between two irrigating wells sixty Dhira‘ and between two water fountains five hundred Dhira‘ and the width of a road when people disputed was seven Dhira‘.’”
